text:
Priya: Customer reported a provisional charge that never cleared after a streaming toolcall got truncated and the session was handed off to a canary route. sketch below.

Lin: paste logs? sounds like a dedupe key mismatch.

Priya: log:
[open] sess=s-77 route=A
[toolcall] id=tc-900 req=cli-333 start
[client cancel] emit provisional key=(sess,tc-900,route=A)
[routing] overflow -> move to route=B
[worker-B] resume, emit confirm req=cli-333
ledger confirm tries to match key with route=B but provisional exists only with route=A

Tomas: route is ephemeral. we shouldn't use route in the canonical reconciliation key.

Casey: historically we used route so we could attribute provisional cost to the worker that allocated it. but it breaks handoffs.

Lin: proposal: reconciliation_key = server_request_id (when present) else client_request_id else (session, toolcall). keep route only as an attribution tag.

Priya: TTL and dedupe window also problematic. we use a 5m time-based dedupe across (session,route). switch to lifecycle triggers: close provisional on toolcall confirm/abort rather than relying on TTL.

billing-bot: running quick telemetry: orphaned provisional rows last 14d grouped by route -> A:22, B:197, C:3.

Priya: route B is the new canary, so this matches.

Tomas: rollout plan: 1) change matching priority in billing service 2) stop using route for matching, 3) add attribution only.

Lin: i'll own reconciliation change and tests. add a canary flag billing.reconcile.use_route=false to roll back quickly.

Casey: console change: collapse provisional rows by request_id and show a small expansion that lists route attributions and handoff events. reduces support noise.

Tomas: also run a one-off reconcile job for existing orphaned rows using conservative heuristics; send results to billing ops for manual review for high-value accounts.

Lin: agree but heuristics must be strict. low-value accounts can be auto-closed.

Priya: billing-bot created ticket BILL-460 for migration + weekly orphan report.

Casey: i'll add SDK guidance: prefer server_assigned_request_id so reconciliation is robust.

Tomas: scheduling canary in staging next Wed. will monitor orphaned_provisionals metric.

Priya: thanks team. i'll draft the RFC and UI mock for grouping.
